meta.name: add-codex
meta.description: Use Codex (OpenAI's codex app-server) as a full agent provider — planning, tool orchestration, MCP tools, server-side history, session resume — alongside or instead of Claude. ChatGPT subscription or OpenAI API key, vault-only via OneCLI. Per-group via `ncl groups config update --provider codex`. Distinct from using OpenAI as an MCP tool (where Claude remains the planner).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 Codex 设为主智能体,接替 Claude 做规划、调用工具并恢复历史会话。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果希望终端 AI 的规划与工具调度由 Codex 接管。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want Codex to lead planning and tool calls in your terminal instead of Claude.

howto.what: 给 NanoClaw 装上 Codex 作为分组的完整 agent 后端:由它做规划、工具编排、MCP 工具调用,并保留服务端会话历史与会话续接;凭证只存在 vault 里。它不同于把 OpenAI 当 MCP 工具——那种情况下 Claude 仍是规划者。
howto.when: 当你要让某个分组改用 Codex 而不是 Claude,或要安装、认证这个提供方时使用。切换是运维操作,在主机上执行;新分组默认仍是 claude,除非你显式改实例默认。

say.text: 把这个分组的后端切到 codex,然后重启它
帮我安装并认证 Codex 提供方,用 ChatGPT 订阅登录
say.note: 运行 provider-auth codex 的认证流程

say.text: 把新分组的默认 agent 后端设为 codex

howto.what_en: Adds Codex as a full agent backend for a NanoClaw group: planning, tool orchestration, MCP tools, server-side history, session resume. Credentials stay vault-only. Different from using OpenAI as an MCP tool, where Claude stays the planner.
howto.when_en: Use when a group should run on Codex instead of Claude, or when installing and authenticating the provider. Switching is an operator action from the host; new groups stay claude by default.

say_en.text: Switch this group's provider to codex and restart it
say_en.note: Runs ncl groups config update and restart

say_en.text: Install and authenticate the Codex provider with my ChatGPT subscription
Set codex as the default provider for new groups
say_en.note: Sets DEFAULT_AGENT_PROVIDER and restarts the host
